name: Mothers and Daughters
source:
In Mothers and Daughters, you play as Max—an 18-year-old college freshman venturing into adult life. With a diverse cast of love interests and multiple paths to take you on a journey through the story, will you be led by lust and seduce every woman you meet, or will you win over and pursue that one special woman?

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2508400/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在《Mothers and Daughters》中，你将扮演18岁的大学新生麦克斯，迈入成人生活。面对各具特色的恋爱对象，以及通往不同故事的多条道路，你会受欲望驱使，诱惑每一个遇见的女人，还是赢得那位特别之人的芳心，专心追求她？

[编辑自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2508400/]Steam[/url]]
